{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -eu
mkdir -p temp_check
# Save original var (allow empty)
printf '%s' "${var-}" > temp_check/original_var.txt
# Normalize to single line: convert CR to LF, then newlines to space, collapse whitespace sequences to single space
tr '\r' '\n' < temp_check/original_var.txt | tr '\n' ' ' | sed -E 's/[[:space:]]+/ /g' > temp_check/normalized_var.txt
# Detect leading/trailing whitespace in normalized_var.txt
s=$(cat temp_check/normalized_var.txt)
leading=false; trailing=false
if [ -n "$s" ]; then
  first_char="${s:0:1}"
  last_char="${s: -1}"
  if [[ "$first_char" == ' ' || "$first_char" == $'\t' ]]; then leading=true; fi
  if [[ "$last_char" == ' ' || "$last_char" == $'\t' ]]; then trailing=true; fi
fi
printf 'leading:%s\ntrailing:%s\n' "$leading" "$trailing" > temp_check/whitespace_log.txt
# Coerce normalized value into canonical numeric string using Python's Decimal
python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
s=open('temp_check/normalized_var.txt','r',encoding='utf-8').read()
s_strip=s.strip()
canonical=s_strip
changed=False
try:
    d=Decimal(s_strip)
    if d == d.to_integral():
        canonical = str(int(d))
    else:
        nn = d.normalize()
        canonical = format(nn, 'f')
except InvalidOperation:
    canonical = s_strip
changed = (canonical != s_strip)
open('temp_check/canonical_numeric.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(canonical)
open('temp_check/coercion_log.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write('changed:' + ('true' if changed else 'false') + '\noriginal:' + s_strip + '\ncanonical:' + canonical + '\n')
PY
# Digit check: only optional leading sign and digits
canonical=$(cat temp_check/canonical_numeric.txt)
if [[ "$canonical" =~ ^[+-]?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "true" > temp_check/digit_check.txt
else
  echo "false" > temp_check/digit_check.txt
fi
# Fraction/exponent check: ensure no '.' or 'e'/'E'
if [[ "$canonical" != *.* && "$canonical" != *[eE]* ]]; then
  echo "true" > temp_check/fraction_exponent_check.txt
else
  echo "false" > temp_check/fraction_exponent_check.txt
fi
# Merge outcomes
d=$(cat temp_check/digit_check.txt)
f=$(cat temp_check/fraction_exponent_check.txt)
if [ "$d" = "true" ] && [ "$f" = "true" ]; then
  echo "integer_candidate: true" > temp_check/integer_candidate_status.txt
  echo "notes: canonical representation matches integer notation." >> temp_check/integer_candidate_status.txt
else
  echo "integer_candidate: false" > temp_check/integer_candidate_status.txt
  echo "notes: digit_check=$d, fraction_exponent_check=$f" >> temp_check/integer_candidate_status.txt
fi
# Ready file
echo "All preparatory checks complete. Ready for final determination and output." > temp_check/ready_for_final.txt
# Final determination
if [ "$d" = "true" ] && [ "$f" = "true" ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
